data.name: ShoJinDen
data.detailed_description:
🏯 ShoJinDen

Cut through waves of enemies and face over a dozen powerful bosses in intense one-on-one battles.

Customize your skills to expand your combat style, from grounded sword fighting focused on close-range blade combat to dynamic aerial attacks.

Deliver the final blow with your blade and carve your own path through destiny.

🔸 Overview

ShoJinDen is a Japanese-style sword-fighting action game that blends precision, timing, and cinematic beauty.
Unleash graceful slashes, fire the Phantom Edge (Homing Laser), and exploit your enemy’s brief openings to land your devastating Enzan (Flame Slash).
It’s a battle of pure focus—where one mistake can be fatal and one strike can turn the tide.

⚔️ Features

  • “Enzan” – the ultimate finishing technique
    Build energy by landing hits, ranged attacks, or successful guards.
    When the gauge is full, unleash Enzan, a powerful flaming strike that deals massive damage.
    The system encourages aggressive, high-tempo combat that rewards precision and timing.

  • Intense duels and large-scale battles
    Face numerous Igyou (aberrations) in both one-on-one and multi-enemy encounters.
    Learn their patterns and seize your chance for victory.

  • A beautifully atmospheric Japanese world
    Towering castles under the moonlight, ancient shrines, and burning skies—
    all brought to life with Unreal Engine’s expressive visuals.

  • Deep immersion
    Music and camera direction create a dramatic contrast between tension and tranquility.

⚔️ About the Full Version

The full version of ShoJinDen expands the world with five times more stages
and over a dozen boss encounters.
You’ll start with zero skill points, but as you clear all stages—including
Normal, Normal Time Attack, and Hard Modes—you’ll unlock the ability to
use all skills and full command techniques, unleashing the true essence of ShoJinDen.

Finishing the game is not the end—it’s where the real challenge begins.

⚔️Demo Version

  • Play through the opening stages of the game.

  • Start with an increased number of initial skill points.

  • Save functionality is not available.

  • Progress and data cannot be carried over to the full version.


    🌕 Recommended For

  • Players who enjoy tense, skill-based combat

  • Fans of Japanese-style sword and boss-centric action games

  • Those seeking a deep combat system that rewards mastery and aggression


    🔸Controller Notice

    This game does not support Steam Input.

    An Xbox-compatible controller is recommended.

🛠️ Developer

  • Developer: Eigetsu Games

  • Engine: Unreal Engine

  • Supported Languages: Japanese / English (Subtitles)

data.short_description: Master your blade and forge your own style. Fight with precision in grounded sword battles or soar through the air with long-range attacks. An intense Japanese 3D action game where every strike shapes your destiny.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 730 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed for quiet, low-spec environments. No save data is created in the demo.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 730 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: For best experience, use headphones and play in a quiet environment.
